Same-day dentistry

Crowns and veneers in one visit.

A digital scan replaces messy impressions. The crown or veneer is designed on screen with you, milled in the clinic and fitted the same day. No temporary tooth, no second trip.

  1. Scan

    Intraoral scanner, no impression trays.

  2. Design

    You see the shape and shade on screen.

  3. Mill

    CAD/CAM milling in the clinic.

  4. Fit

    Polished and bonded the same day.

Equipment named on the current site: CEREC CAD/CAM, dental microscopes, digital scanners. Confirm equipment list

Questions

Before your consultation.

Is the cosmetic consultation free?
Yes, cosmetic and implant consultations are listed at ₹0 on the clinic's 2026 price list. X-rays or a CBCT scan, if needed, are charged separately.
Do veneers damage my teeth?
Porcelain veneers usually need a thin layer of enamel removed. Composite and some CAD/CAM veneers need little or none. Dr Goel explains the trade-off for your teeth at the consultation.
How white will whitening make my teeth?
It depends on your starting shade and the cause of staining. Your shade is recorded before and after. Fluorosis or tetracycline stains may respond better to veneers.
Is the clinic a certified Invisalign provider?
The clinic offers Invisalign with a free intraoral scan and a simulation of the result. Provider tier to be confirmed.
Can it be finished before my wedding?
Often, yes. Whitening, bonding and many veneer cases are completed within days. Tell us your date when you book.
